scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @repo/shared build && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @repo/shared dev" "pnpm --filter api dev" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @repo/shared build && pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter api build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @repo/shared build && pnpm --filter @repo/shared test && pnpm --filter api test && pnpm --filter api test:contract && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.e2e: pnpm --filter @repo/shared build && pnpm --filter web exec playwright test
